snippet.title: 14: Overmind — Survival in Anomalous Space | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
🚀 *Play the 14: Overmind Demo on Steam* - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3610160/14_Overmind_Demo/

⚠️ *Wishlist 14: Overmind on Steam* - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2691090/14__Overmind/

14: Overmind is an immersive first-person survival adventure set in anomalous deep space, where mysterious zones distort reality and alter the laws of physics.

Explore hostile sectors, gather resources, upgrade your equipment, build a base and use vehicles to survive as you uncover what happened — and who you are.

14: Overmind is coming to PC via Steam in 2027. The playable demo is available now.
